name: Snyder's of Hanover Gluten-Free Pretzel Sticks
whyItWorks: Crafted from potato starch, tapioca starch, and cellulose gum, baked into crisp golden sticks with coarse salt. Certified gluten-free, dairy-free, and seedless. Digests smoothly and provides reliable sodium during dehydration.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat straight from the bag or dip into smooth peanut butter or mild cheddar dip.
